records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with zero product progress: no first project, no invite, no key milestone. Two outreach emails (email:712eb767, email:9d1bec96) went unanswered, no tickets filed — no signal of engagement. Team plan and active subscription give some upside, but 8 days of silence-driven self-start is unlikely.

draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Following up on my last note — no reply needed, I know setup weeks get busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything about your Team plan setup.

Best,
Chidi
